warning_break_short: Break shorter than required (30 min after 6 h, 45 min after 9 h)
warning_rest_short: Less than 11 hours of rest since the previous day
warning_long_running: Clocked in for over 12 hours. Forgot to clock out?
comp_time_hint: Time off paid from your overtime. The day's target stays, so your balance goes down.
credit_hint: The day counts as worked. Your balance stays the same.
select_hint: Tap days to select them, then mark an absence or add the target time
select_hint_month: Tap days or drag across a range, then mark an absence or add the target time
presets_hint: Quick break durations on the Today screen. The break ends by itself.
auto_break_hint: If less break was recorded than required
warnings_hint: Breaks, 10 h limit and rest time (ArbZG)
rounding_nearest_hint: Clock-in and clock-out are rounded to the nearest step. The exact time is kept as well.
rounding_employer_hint: Clock-in rounds up and clock-out rounds down. The exact time is kept as well.
rounding_off_hint: Stamps are stored to the minute.
backup_export_hint: Backup, restore, move to another device
data_local_hint: All data stays on this device.
schedule_added: Change added. Set the new hours above.
weekly_hours_hint: Weekly hours spread evenly over the workdays. Set a day to 0:00 to make it a day off.
schedule_history_hint: Add a change when your hours change, e.g. part time from a date. Past days keep their old target.
tracking_start_hint: Days before this date only count toward the balance if you recorded something for them.
set_balance_hint: Adds a correction for today so the balance matches, e.g. after moving from another tool.
add_adjustment_hint: For example overtime paid out (−) or credited (+).
carry_over_manual_hint: Set by hand, can be negative
carry_over_expires_hint: Leave empty if it doesn't expire
default_entitlement_hint: Used for years without their own setting.
booked_vacation_empty: Mark vacation in the calendar: tap Select, pick the days, then Mark.
backup_hint: {segments} entries and {absences} absences. The backup file contains everything, including settings.
backup_restore_hint: Replaces all data on this device
restore_newer: This backup is from a newer app version. Please update first.
restore_invalid: This is not a PunchClock backup.
restore_confirm: Replace all data on this device with the backup from {date} ({count} entries)? This can't be undone.
transfer_step1: Tap Create backup and save or send the file.
transfer_step2: Open PunchClock on the new device.
transfer_step3: Tap Restore backup (or Restore from backup during setup) and pick the file.
wipe_confirm: All entries, absences and settings on this device will be deleted. Create a backup first if you want to keep them.
notif_reminder_body: You've been clocked in for {hours} hours. Forgot to clock out?
android_only_body: Browsers can't show a lasting notification or see Wi-Fi networks. The Android app can.
notifications_hint: Shows the running time with Break and Clock out buttons while you're clocked in.
wifi_trigger_hint: Clock in when your phone joins the work Wi-Fi and clock out when it leaves.
wifi_enable: Use Wi-Fi to clock in and out
wifi_none: Not connected to a Wi-Fi, or location permission missing.
wifi_mode_ask_hint: You get a notification with a Clock in button.
wifi_mode_auto_hint: Stamps right away and tells you with a notification.
wifi_clock_out_hint: Uses the time the Wi-Fi was lost
wifi_grace_hint: Short drop-outs don't split your day
permissions_hint: Android only shows Wi-Fi names to apps with location access. PunchClock never reads or stores your location.
perm_location_hint: Needed to see the Wi-Fi name
perm_background_hint: Needed while the app is closed
perm_battery_hint: Keeps Wi-Fi detection working in the background
automation_apps_hint: Other apps can stamp by sending a broadcast intent with one of these actions:
setup_welcome_body: Track your working time, breaks, overtime and vacation. Everything stays on this device.
setup_hours_body: You can change this any time in the settings.
setup_start_body: Moving from another tool? Enter your current numbers.
setup_balance_hint: Negative if you owe hours, e.g. -2:30
break_unplaced_hint: Taken somewhere in this entry. Leave at 0:00 if you record breaks separately.
add_target_time_hint: For days without exact times. Starts at {time} with the legal break.
default_start_hint: Used when a day is filled with its target time.
